verdict.rationale: Meltano is explicitly CLI-driven, dockerizable, and documented for DataOps CI/CD workflows (version control, CI/CD, code review) and scheduled/orchestrated pipelines via Airflow, all of which enable headless automation. Independent evidence confirms production use (GitLab running pipelines) without a GUI dependency. Missing for 10: no explicit CI-platform-specific guide (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI example) or hands-on CI log evidence beyond general production usage.
